# Brookings Institution

> > Independent research and policy analysis on global affairs, economics, governance, and international relations

The Brookings Institution is a nonprofit public policy organization conducting in-depth research on domestic and international issues. This collection features analysis on India, China, US foreign policy, immigration, healthcare, sustainable finance, and geopolitical dynamics from experts including Subir Gokarn, W.P.S. Sidhu, and Nicholas R. Lardy.

## Key Topics

- India policy and governance
- US-China relations
- Foreign policy analysis
- Climate change and sustainability
- Modi government
- Immigration and STEM workers
- Economic relations and trade
- Geopolitical dynamics
- Healthcare policy
- Sustainable finance
- Congressional testimony
- India-China relations
- Trade normalization
- Political commentary
- Brookings India research

## India Policy and Governance

- [Modi's delivery challenges](https://www.brookings.edu/articles/modis-delivery-challenges): Analysis of Narendra Modi's governance challenges in India by W.P.S. Sidhu
- [Dimming of Brand India](https://www.brookings.edu/articles/dimming-of-brand-india): Commentary by Vikram Mehta on India's changing global image and reputation
- [Health care - how, where & how much?](https://www.brookings.edu/articles/health-care-how-where-how-much): Subir Gokarn commentary on India's healthcare policy challenges
- [Tur travails - Three components of a structural solution to the pain caused by price spikes](https://www.brookings.edu/articles/tur-travails-three-components-of-a-structural-solution-to-the-pain-caused-by-price-spikes): Subir Gokarn on structural solutions to commodity price spikes in India

## International Relations and Geopolitics

- [Hearings on Normalizing Economic Relations with China](https://www.brookings.edu/articles/hearings-on-normalizing-economic-relations-with-china): Nicholas Lardy testimony on US-China trade normalization from 1997 hearing
- [Strategic Importance of Ufa Summits](https://www.brookings.edu/articles/strategic-importance-of-ufa-summits): W.P.S. Sidhu analyzes geopolitical significance of Ufa summits for India
- [Hearing echoes of 1914 in 2014](https://www.brookings.edu/articles/hearing-echoes-of-1914-in-2014): W.P.S. Sidhu compares WWI-era geopolitics to 2014 Asia-Pacific dynamics
- [Fighting without fighting](https://www.brookings.edu/articles/fighting-without-fighting): Subir Gokarn op-ed on conflict resolution and foreign policy approaches

## Economic Policy and Sustainability

- [Finance and Sustainability: Regulatory and Strategic Dimensions](https://www.brookings.edu/articles/finance-and-sustainability-regulatory-and-strategic-dimensions): Subir Gokarn on regulatory and strategic aspects of sustainable finance
- [Why a Temporary Immigration Solution is Still Problematic for STEM Workers](https://www.brookings.edu/articles/why-a-temporary-immigration-solution-is-still-problematic-for-stem-workers): Analysis of temporary visa challenges facing STEM workers and immigration

## About Brookings

- [Newsletters](https://www.brookings.edu/newsletters): Subscribe to Brookings newsletters on research, policy, and events
- [Editors and Contributors](https://www.brookings.edu/articles/editors-and-contributors): List of Brookings editors and contributors including Subir Gokarn
